meta.title: [BRIEF-421] refactor: Rename The Accent Button Variant To Primary
meta.body:
### Overview

Renames `ButtonVariants.ACCENT` to `PRIMARY` and its value from `"accent"` to `"primary"`, covering the call sites, the tests, the snapshot and the `[data-variant]` selectors. PR 4 fills the primary with the brand colour, so a variant named `accent` would misname it once the light accent stops being the primary fill. Nothing changes on screen. It's a separate PR so PR 4's diff shows only the colour change.

Verification: `pnpm -C apps/web typecheck` 0, `test` 0, `lint` 0; `pnpm lint` 0.
